N consecutive higher-index packets arrive (default N=32)\n142\t *\n143\t * This prevents discarding nearly-complete blocks (e.g., 95% done) when camera\n144\t * frames straddle sender block transitions, which would otherwise waste hours\n145\t * of work waiting for a full pass.\n146\t *\n147\t * See: docs/notes/bf-2t1k-block-switch-policy.md\n148\t *\n149\t * **I5 Resolution (bf-28b):** The invariant permits two concurrent GE contexts:\n150\t * - `active`: one payload block's GE decoder (regular blocks)\n151\t * - `manifestActive`: one manifest block's GE decoder (manifest stream at blockIndex 0xFFFFFF)\n152\t *\n153\t * This is necessary because manifest blocks are interleaved with payload blocks (§7.6),\n154\t * and both require fountain decoding. ==============================================================================\n333\t\n334\t/**\n335\t * Valid receiver state transitions.\n336\t *\n337\t * Key: [from_state] -> Set<to_state>\n338\t */\n339\texport const VALID_RECV_TRANSITIONS: Record<string, Set<string>> = {\n340\t  'idle': new Set(['acquiring']),\n341\t  'acquiring': new Set(['receiving', 'paused', 'idle']),\n342\t  'receiving': new Set(['verifying', 'paused', 'quota-exhausted', 'decompress-failed']),\n343\t  'verifying': new Set(['complete', 'receiving', 'decompress-failed']),\n344\t  'complete': new }\n386\t}\n387\t\n388\t/**\n389\t * Assert a sender transition is valid, throw if not.\n390\t */\n391\texport function assertSendTransition(from: string, to: string): void {\n392\t  if ==============================================================================\n398\t// STATE UTILITIES\n399\t// ==============================================================================\n400\t\n401\t/**\n402\t * Check if a receiver state can be resumed (D22).\n403\t *\n404\t * Resume is NOT supported when compression is enabled because:\n405\t * - CompressionStream offers no determinism guarantee across browser restarts\n406\t * - Re-compression after staging reaping (E11) may produce different     docs/notes/bf-2vke-compression-resume-t4-reap-interaction.md\n416\t */\n417\texport function canResumeRecv(state: RecvSessionState): boolean {\n418\t  if (state.type !== 'paused' && state.type !== 'complete') {\n419\t    return false;\n420\t  }\n421\t\n422\t  // Check beacon flags for resume disabled\n423\t  const meta = state.type === 'paused' ? state.previousState.meta : state.meta;\n424\t  if (isResumeDisabled(meta.flags)) {\n425\t    return false;\n426\t  }\n427\t\n428\t  return true;\n429\t}\n430\t\n431\t/**\n432\t * Get all missing block indices from a bitmap.\n433\t */\n434\texport function getMissingBlocks(bitmap: Uint8Array): number[] {\n435\t  const missing: number[] = [];\n436\t  for (let i = 0; i < bitmap.length * 8; i++) {\n437\t    const byteIndex = Math.floor(i / 8);\n438\t    const bitIndex = i % 8;\n439\t    if (!(bitmap[byteIndex] & (1 << bitIndex))) {\n440\t      missing.push(i);\n441\t    }\n442\t  }\n443\t  return missing;\n444\t}\n445\t\n446\t/**\n447\t * Check if bitmap is complete (all bits set).\n448\t */\n449\texport function isBitmapComplete(bitmap: Uint8Array): boolean {\n450\t  for (const byte of bitmap) {\n451\t    if (byte !== 0xff) {\n452\t      return false;\n453\t    }\n454\t  }\n455\t  return true;\n456\t}\n457\t\n458\t/**\n459\t * Clear a bit in the bitmap (for E12 block hash failure).\n460\t */\n461\texport function clearBitmapBit(bitmap: Uint8Array, blockIndex: number): void {\n462\t  const byteIndex = Math.floor(blockIndex / 8);\n463\t  const bitIndex = blockIndex % 8;\n464\t  bitmap[byteIndex] &= ~(1 << bitIndex);\n465\t}\n466\t\n467\t/**\n468\t * Set a bit in the bitmap (block complete).\n469\t */\n470\texport function setBitmapBit(bitmap: Uint8Array, blockIndex: number): void {\n471\t  const byteIndex = Math.floor(blockIndex / 8);\n472\t  const bitIndex = blockIndex % 8;\n473\t  bitmap[byteIndex] |= (1 << bitIndex);\n474\t}\n475\t\n476\t// ==============================================================================\n477\t// BLOCK POSITION TRACKING FOR WRITES\n478\t// ==============================================================================\n479\t\n480\t/**\n481\t * Concrete implementation of WritePositionTracker.\n482\t *\n483\t * Manages block position tracking for out-of-order writes.\n484\t * Integrates with the bitmap-based tracking in BaseRecvState.\n485\t */\n486\texport class WritePositionTrackerImpl implements WritePositionTracker {\n487\t  private _currentPosition: number;\n488\t  private _blocksWritten: number;\n489\t  private readonly state: BaseRecvState;\n490\t\n491\t  constructor(state: BaseRecvState) {\n492\t    this.state = state;\n493\t    this._currentPosition = 0;\n494\t    this._blocksWritten = 0;\n495\t\n496\t    // Initialize from existing state\n497\t    this._blocksWritten = getBlocksWrittenCount(state);\n498\t    this._currentPosition = getCurrentWritePosition(state);\n499\t  }\n500\t\n501\t  /**\n502\t   * Current write position as block index.\n503\t   * Tracks the next expected block to be written.\n504\t   */\n505\t  get currentPosition(): number {\n506\t    return this._currentPosition;\n507\t  }\n508\t\n509\t  /**\n510\t   * Total number of blocks written so far.\n511\t   */\n512\t  get blocksWritten(): number {\n513\t    return this._blocksWritten;\n514\t  }\n515\t\n516\t  /**\n517\t   * Get the next position to write.\n518\t   * Returns the first incomplete block index at or after the current position.\n519\t   */\n520\t  getNextPosition(): number {\n521\t    return getNextWritePosition(this.state, this._currentPosition);\n522\t  }\n523\t\n524\t  /**\n525\t   * Update position after a successful write.\n526\t   * Advances to the next incomplete block.\n527\t   */\n528\t  advancePosition(): void {\n529\t    // Find next unwritten block\n530\t    const nextPos = this.getNextPosition();\n531\t\n532\t    // If we found a new unwritten block, advance to it\n533\t    if (nextPos !== this._currentPosition) {\n534\t      this._currentPosition = nextPos;\n535\t    } else {\n536\t      // No advancement needed, stay at current position\n537\t      // (block at current position was already marked as written)\n538\t    }\n539\t\n540\t    // Recalculate blocks written count\n541\t    this._blocksWritten = getBlocksWrittenCount(this.state);\n542\t  }\n543\t\n544\t  /**\n545\t   * Reset position to a specific block index.\n546\t   * Used during resume or error recovery.\n547\t   */\n548\t  setPosition(position: number): void {\n549\t    if (position < 0 || position > this.state.meta.blockCount) {\n550\t      throw new Error(`Invalid position: ${position} (must be 0-${this.state.meta.blockCount})`);\n551\t    }\n552\t    this._currentPosition = position;\n553\t  }\n554\t\n555\t  /**\n556\t   * Mark a block as written and update position tracking.\n557\t   * This is a convenience method that combines marking and position update.\n558\t   */\n559\t  markBlockWritten(blockIndex: number): void {\n560\t    if (!isBlockWritten(this.state, blockIndex)) {\n561\t      markBlockWritten(this.state, blockIndex);\n562\t      this._blocksWritten++;\n563\t\n564\t      // If this was the current position, advance to next\n565\t      if (blockIndex === this._currentPosition) {\n566\t        this.advancePosition();\n567\t      }\n568\t    }\n569\t  }\n570\t\n571\t  /**\n572\t   * Check if a block has been written.\n573\t   */\n574\t  isBlockWritten(blockIndex: number): boolean {\n575\t    return isBlockWritten(this.state, blockIndex);\n576\t  }\n577\t\n578\t  /**\n579\t   * Get all unwritten block indices.\n580\t   */\n581\t  getUnwrittenBlocks(): number[] {\n582\t    return getUnwrittenBlocks(this.state);\n583\t  }\n584\t\n585\t  /**\n586\t   * Check if all blocks have been written.\n587\t   */\n588\t  isComplete(): boolean {\n589\t    return areAllBlocksWritten(this.state);\n590\t  }\n591\t\n592\t  /**\n593\t   * Get write progress as a ratio (0.0 to 1.0).\n594\t   */\n595\t  getProgress(): number {\n596\t    return getWriteProgress(this.state);\n597\t  }\n598\t}\n599\t\n600\t/**\n601\t * Check if a block has been written to output.\n602\t */\n603\texport function isBlockWritten(state: BaseRecvState, blockIndex: number): boolean {\n604\t  const byteIndex = Math.floor(blockIndex / 8);\n605\t  const bitIndex = blockIndex % 8;\n606\t  return (state.writtenBlocks[byteIndex] & (1 << bitIndex)) !== 0;\n607\t}\n608\t\n609\t/**\n610\t * Mark a block as written to output.\n611\t */\n612\texport function markBlockWritten(state: BaseRecvState, blockIndex: number): void {\n613\t  const byteIndex = Math.floor(blockIndex / 8);\n614\t  const bitIndex = blockIndex % 8;\n615\t  state.writtenBlocks[byteIndex] |= (1 << bitIndex);\n616\t}\n617\t\n618\t/**\n619\t * Get count of blocks written so far.\n620\t */\n621\texport function getBlocksWrittenCount(state: BaseRecvState): number {\n622\t  let count = 0;\n623\t  for (const byte of state.writtenBlocks) {\n624\t    count += popcount(byte);\n625\t  }\n626\t  return count;\n627\t}\n628\t\n629\t/**\n630\t * Population count (number of set bits) for a byte.\n631\t * Used for bitmap operations.\n632\t */\n633\tfunction popcount(x: number): number {\n634\t  x = x - ((x >> 1) & 0x55);\n635\t  x = (x & 0x33) + ((x >> 2) & 0x33);\n636\t  return (x + (x >> 4)) & 0x0f;\n637\t}\n638\t\n639\t/**\n640\t * Get all block indices that have been decoded but not yet written.\n641\t */\n642\texport function getUnwrittenBlocks(state: BaseRecvState): number[] {\n643\t  const unwritten: number[] = [];\n644\t  const blockCount = state.meta.blockCount;\n645\t\n646\t  for (let i = 0; i < blockCount; i++) {\n647\t    const byteIndex = Math.floor(i / 8);\n648\t    const bitIndex = i % 8;\n649\t\n650\t    const     unwritten.push(i);\n655\t    }\n656\t  }\n657\t\n658\t  return unwritten;\n659\t}\n660\t\n661\t/**\n662\t * Check if all complete blocks have been written.\n663\t */\n664\texport function 8);\n669\t    const bitIndex = i % 8;\n670\t\n671\t    const complete = (state.complete[byteIndex] & (1 << bitIndex)) !== 0;\n672\t    const written = (state.writtenBlocks[byteIndex] & (1 << bitIndex)) !== 0;\n673\t\n674\t    if (complete && !written) {\n675\t      return false;\n676\t    }\n677\t  }\n678\t\n679\t  return true;\n680\t}\n681\t\n682\t/**\n683\t * Calculate the current write position as a block index.\n684\t * Returns the first incomplete block index at or after the given start index.\n685\t */\n686\texport function getNextWritePosition(state: BaseRecvState, startIndex = 0): number {\n687\t  const blockCount = state.meta.blockCount;\n688\t\n689\t  for (let i = startIndex; i < blockCount; i++) {\n690\t    if (!isBlockWritten(state, i)) {\n691\t      return i;\n692\t    }\n693\t  }\n694\t\n695\t  return blockCount; // All blocks written\n696\t}\n697\t\n698\t/**\n699\t * Get the current write position as a block index.\n700\t * Returns the index of the next block to block is already written\n721\t */\n722\texport async function writeTrackedBlock(\n723\t  state: BaseRecvState,\n724\t  handle: PositionalWriteHandle,\n725\t  blockData: Uint8Array,\n726\t  blockIndex: number,\n727\t  blockSize: number\n728\t): Promise<void> {\n729\t  // Check if block is already written\n730\t  if (isBlockWritten(state, blockIndex)) {\n731\t    throw new Error(`Block ${blockIndex} is already written`);\n732\t  }\n733\t\n734\t  // Calculate offset\n735\t  const offset = blockIndex * blockSize;\n736\t\n737\t  // Write at specific offset\n738\t  await handle.write(blockData, { at: offset });\n739\t\n740\t  // Mark block as written\n741\t  markBlockWritten(state, blockIndex);\n742\t}\n743\t\n744\t/**\n745\t * Reset write tracking for a block (allows = Math.floor(blockIndex / 8);\n755\t  const bitIndex = blockIndex % 8;\n756\t  state.writtenBlocks[byteIndex] &= ~(1 << bitIndex);\n757\t}\n758\t\n759\t/**\n760\t * Get write progress as a progress ratio (0.0 = none written, 1.0 = all written)\n766\t */\n767\texport function getWriteProgress(state: BaseRecvState): number {\n768\t  const total = state.meta.blockCount;\n769\t  if (total === 0) return 1.0;\n770\t  const written = getBlocksWrittenCount(state);\n771\t  return written / total;\n772\t}\n773\t\n774\t// ==============================================================================\n775\t// RESUME TOKEN (D22)\n776\t// ==============================================================================\n777\t\n778\t/**\n779\t * Resume token for persisting session state.\n780\t *\n781\t * Includes the manifest (§7.6) to enable re-verification of block hashes on resume.\n782\t * Without the persisted manifest, a reload would lose all received blocks because:\n783\t * - The manifest takes ~12 minutes to acquire for a 4 GB file (at ~2 s beacon cadence)\n784\t * - During that window, blocks cannot be verified against their hashes\n785\t * - By §7.6's two-bitmap rule, blocks written before verification are NOT in the resume bitmap\n786\t * - So the resume token would be empty and all progress would be lost\n787\t *\n788\t * See: docs/notes/bf-28q-manifest-resume-persistence.md\n789\t */\n790\texport interface ResumeToken {\n791\t  streamId: number;\n792\t  meta: BeaconMeta;\n793\t  complete: Uint8Array;  // bitmap of complete blocks\n794\t  writtenBlocks: Uint8Array;  // bitmap of written blocks\n795\t  manifest: BlockHashManifest | null;  // block hashes for verification (may be null if not yet acquired)\n796\t  timestamp: number;\n797\t}\n798\t\n799\t/**\n800\t * Create a resume token from a resumable state.\n801\t *\n802\t * When compression is enabled, resume is NOT supported because:\n803\t * - CompressionStream offers no determinism guarantee across browser restarts\n804\t * -
